# Brush importer fixtures

- `rubberduck.gbr`: rubberduck, 60 Free Gimp & Krita Brushes, CC0-1.0. https://opengameart.org/content/60-free-gimp-krita-brushes . Original filename: fractale1.gbr.
- `krita-basic.kpp`, `krita-small.bundle`: Krita 4 Default Resources, CC0 per bundle meta.xml (Krita commit 69a4ea48fa88c136c1166eb59dddf894c149d9f8). Authors Deevad, Ramon Miranda, Razvanc, Radian, Wolthera, Storm, Scottyp and others. https://invent.kde.org/graphics/krita/-/tree/master/krita/data/bundles . The small bundle retains one original preset with a reduced manifest; the standalone KPP is the same preset.
- `plain-stitch.brush`: Jay Versluis, Plain Stitch, CC0-1.0. https://www.versluis.com/2015/01/procreate-stitch-and-sequin-brushes/ . Licence: https://www.versluis.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/License-Procreate-Brushes.txt . Unchanged original file.
- `charcoal.myb`: Martin Renold and MyPaint team, CC0-1.0 per Licenses.dep5, MyPaint brushes commit 08da4a48fa88c136c1166eb59dddf894c149d9f8. https://github.com/mypaint/mypaint-brushes . Unchanged original file.

GBR v1/v2, GIH grid cells, shaped VBR, hostile ZIP/plist/XML, and brushsets are generated in tests from the public format descriptions. No additional downloaded artwork is redistributed.
